epic.summary: Cash Settlement based on Average Price

business_context: This ticket is to change the way of PL calculation for FX Spot instruments from FIFO to avg.price.

synthesis.problem_gist: Shift FX Spot P/L and related position metrics from strict FIFO to average-price (and configured hybrid) behavior per linked CT requirements: instrument-type configuration, average fill, open P/L, % P/L gross, and weighted-average cash-settlement ladder.

impact_areas.text: Portfolio / position metrics (average fill, open P/L, realized P/L, % PL Gross)
Functional configuration (FIFO vs weighted average by instrument type)

requirements.snippet_text: FIFO: STOCKS, ETF, OPTION, CFD, CFD_STOCKS, CFD_FOREX, FUTURE Weighted Average: FOREX (FX_SPOT subtype) If not configured, FIFO method is used by default. We assume that configuration is not going to be changed for already existing instrument types: such test scenarios can be skipped.

According to the configuration : For FIFO-calculated instruments: weighted average by trades contributing to the currently open net position by FIFO (see ) For WeightedAvg-calculated instruments: weighted average by all opening trades since last crossing 0 (see )

According to the configuration : For FIFO-calculated instruments : (position_qty * mark price - open cost) * multiplier , For WeightedAvg-calculated instruments: position_qty * (mark price - average fill price) * multiplier , where: mark price is according to open cost is a sum of costs of all opening trades that remain open by FIFO, signed average price is according to

According to the configuration : For FIFO-calculated instruments : (Open PL / ABS(SUM (open cost * multiplier))) * 100 For WeightedAvg-calculated instruments: (Open PL / ABS( SUM (average price x qty * multiplier))) * 100 where: open cost is a sum of costs of all opening trades that remain open by FIFO, signed average price is according to Open PL is according to , signed Should be rounded to the closest value with 2 decimals.

Average Price, Open PL and Realized PL during cash settlement (for non-equity cash flow) are calculated by weighted average for the instrument types configured accordingly in . The Weighted Average algorithm assumes that PL for each closing trade for the whole history of a position should be calculated based on average position price and not the opening price of the matched opening trades. Only opening trades contributes to position average price. See rounding rules: for average price calculation - according to ; for realized PL - according to ; for open PL - according to . Example the following position history from the moment the position was flat (zero size): 1) BUY +10 @ 99.00 => position: long 10 2) BUY +10 @ 98.00 => position: long 20 3a) SELL -20 @ 99.50 => position: 0 3b) SELL -10 @ 99.50 => position: short 10 4) SELL -10 @ 98.50 => position: short 20 5a) BUY +10 @ 97.25 => position: short 10 5b) BUY +15 @ 98 => position: long 5 6) BUY +10 @ 99.50 => position: long 15 Ask = 99 Bid = 97 Average price and PL calculations for each point: Trade sequence Trade side Trade size Trade price Position net size Position average price Realized PL Effect
